documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s
Intimation Of Record Date For Final Dividend For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: MSTC Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting a revenue from operations of Rs. 94.25 crores and the highest-ever Q1 e-commerce revenue of Rs. 89.49 crores. Management noted the complete exit from the legacy trading and marketing segment in the quarter and discussed progress on new business initiatives including the EPR certificate exchange, TReDS platform, and travel portal. The company's joint venture MMRPL turned profitable during the period, driven by higher feedstock inflows.

guidance.claim: The company is aiming for double-digit growth in its organic business on the way forward.
guidance.quote: And our attempt will definitely be for a double-digit growth on the way forward. It will not be a very, very high growth, it will be incremental growth, and we shall be aiming at double digit growth on the way forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the positive financial trend for the joint venture MMRPL to strengthen and continue.
demand_outlook.quote: And we expect this trend to strengthen and continue, driving towards a healthy financial outlook for this company.

demand_outlook.claim: The implementation of the EPR policy for manufacturers is driving traction for vehicle scrapping.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, so one of the factors which is driving this is basically the EPR policy coming into place for manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The complete thrust on transparency and fair price discovery across sectors is bound to grow.
demand_outlook.quote: Now, there has been a complete thrust on transparency and fair price discovery in all kinds of sectors. So, this is something that basically enables that trend. So, this is something that will is definitely bound to grow.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC decided to remain an asset-light company.
capex_expansion.quote: We also took a decision to remain an asset-light company.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC is in the final stages of exiting the marketing and trading business to focus primarily on being an e-commerce company.
capex_expansion.quote: So as a part of this, we are now in the final stages of exiting from the marketing and trading business, and coupled with the strategic disinvestment of FSNL at the end of last fiscal, we are moving forward to being primarily an e-commerce company foraying further into areas of creating electronic platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is developing a travel portal called MSTC Smart Travel which is in its final stages of testing.
capex_expansion.quote: This portal is also in its final stages of testing, and we expect to operationalize it shortly in the B2B space to begin with, and then extend segmental reach as we gain traction. We have named this offering as MSTC Smart Travel.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC opened a corporate office in New Delhi, which led to some increases in overhead expenses.
capex_expansion.quote: So far overhead expenses are concerned, so you might have seen from our detailed financials, there is not much increase in the employee expenses, employee cost expenses, but there are some increases in the overheads because this year we have opened a corporate office at New Delhi.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has partnered with SBI CAPS to provide end-to-end transaction advisory solutions.
capex_expansion.quote: For this, we have tied up with SBI CAPS to mutually work for providing such end-to-end solutions, leveraging each other's domain expertise.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA percentage of total income was 69.05%, which is nearly 3% higher than the corresponding period of FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA percentage of total income was 69.05%, also nearly 3% higher than the corresponding period of FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Total expenses increased by 16%, driven by a normal increase in salaries, wages, and inflationary pressure.
margins_costs.quote: So, it is generally a normal increase due to increase in the salaries and wages, normal salary wages and inflationary pressure.

margins_costs.claim: MSTC managed to maintain its EBITDA percentage at a similar level year-on-year despite competition and macroeconomic uncertainty.
margins_costs.quote: With respect to the financials, we have been able to maintain EBITDA percentage at a similar level year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses rose by 8.1%, while other overheads increased due to the new Delhi corporate office.
margins_costs.quote: Now, coming to the detail P&L statement of the standalone business where I was explaining that employee benefit expenses has not increased much, it is 8.1%, whereas other overhead has shown an increase, but it will happen because we have now big corporate office at Delhi and accordingly we will see that appreciable increase in the revenue also.

margins_costs.claim: The impairment loss in the joint venture MMRPL decreased to INR 1.44 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Reduction in impairment loss in investment in JV MMRPL is INR1.44 crores, previous year it was INR10.06 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Revenue from operations reached Rs. 94.25 crores, representing a nearly 22% year-on-year increase over the corresponding period last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Revenue from operations has been Rs. 94.25 crores, which is a nearly 22% year-on-year increase over the corresponding period last year.

orders_capacity.claim: E-commerce revenue stood at Rs. 89.49 crores, which is the highest ever Q1 e-commerce revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Riding on the highest ever Q1 e-commerce revenue of Rs. 89.49 crores, this is the highest in the Q1 since your company was listed in 2019 March.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC transacted a gross percentile value of INR 797.37 billion through its portal during FY25-26.
orders_capacity.quote: So I am jumping to the operational performance during '25-'26, company has dealt with INR797.37 billion in terms of gross percentile value that was transacted through our portal.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC developed a specialized portal for DGFT for quota allocation of gold bullion and other commodities.
orders_capacity.quote: And this year we have developed a specialized portal for DGFT for quota allocation of gold bullion and other commodities.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completely exited from the trading and marketing segment in FY26 and recovered dues on the 110% BG model, closing the chapter in this quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We had taken a decision in FY26 to completely exit from the trading and marketing segment and have seamlessly recovered our dues on the 110% BG model, closing the chapter on this legacy segment in this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: MSTC decided to exit from the 110% bank guarantee to maintain a focused approach toward the e-commerce domain.
capital_allocation.quote: And there is a thing, that the positive part that we are now even exiting from the 110% BG that was fully secured but still choose to have a focused approach towards e-commerce domain.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to exit its trading vertical, with the income expected to be out of its business basket by the first quarter of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: So we have decided to exit, and by the first quarter of this year it will be out of our business basket. Already out, but income will be out of our business basket.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that scrap is a cyclical business, with rates going up and down and volumes changing from time to time.
risks_headwinds.quote: But scrap has always been a cyclical thing. The steel sector as such is very cyclical. So, the rates keep going up and down. And the volume of scrap, that also keeps changing from time to time.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced global macroeconomic uncertainty and challenges of scaling up over the last two quarters.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite competition and with the overall global macroeconomic uncertainty looming over the last two quarters and the challenges of scaling up, we have still managed to maintain it at the same level.

risks_headwinds.claim: The development of the ELV scrappage ecosystem across states has progressed slower than originally visualized.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is happening across states, but obviously it has happened at a rate slower than what was originally visualized.

risks_headwinds.claim: A new coal exchange is in its initial stages, and the company is watching how it might impact its coal auction revenues.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this is something at the very, very initial stages and we shall be watching these developments closely to see how they impact our revenue stream going on.

management_commitments.claim: The TReDS project is at an advanced stage, and subject to regulatory approvals, management aims to operationalize it sometime during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This project is also at an advanced stage and subject to regulatory approvals being obtained, we should be able to operationalize this sometime during this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an internal target to hopefully obtain RBI approval and operationalize the TReDS platform within FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, our internal target is hopefully FY27, within FY27.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC is developing a TREDs platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.
management_commitments.quote: MSTC is developing a TREDs platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.

management_commitments.claim: ETP for EPR certification has been developed on behalf of CPCB and is awaiting go ahead for operation.
management_commitments.quote: ETP for EPR certification has been developed on behalf of CPCB and is awaiting go ahead for operation.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to completely exit the trading business income basket by the first quarter of this year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have decided to exit, and by the first quarter of this year it will be out of our business basket.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC expects to launch its new travel portal shortly.
management_commitments.quote: The two major such platforms that we are working on, the EPR, that is ETP, which we have already developed, and the next part of our digital project pipeline is a travel portal which is also in the final developmental stages and which we expect to launch shortly.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
